Member.title: Member
Member.description: Represents a member of the FairGreeter app, categorized as 'INTI', 'ANGGOTA', or 'TERBATAS', and tracks their selection frequency.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Member entity.

name.description: The full name of the member.

type.description: The category of the member: 'INTI', 'ANGGOTA', or 'TERBATAS'.

selectionFrequency.description: The count of how many times this member has been selected as a greeter.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AppStatistics entity.

totalSelectionsMade.description: The cumulative total count of all selections.

membersSelectedAtLeastOnceCount.description: The total number of distinct members selected at least once.

/members/{memberId}.description: Stores individual member profiles and their selection frequency.

/app_statistics/globalStats.description: Singleton document for global application statistics.
